Being a Manufacturer in India, a country with a huge 
population, we believe that we could make a 
difference in sustainability by bringing a change in 
hydration habits. With Save Nature as our vital 
mission, we manufacture our products to last long. 
Preserving Earth is the prime key to ensure that our 
beloved nature remains a source for all to 
appreciate. Nanobot makes sure that the 
manufacturing process causes no harm to the 
environment; that is why our Made in India vacuum 
ﬂask bottles come with the advantages of being 
recycled.

TRUE VACUUM TECHNOLOGY
Our true vacuum technology encompasses two chamber high vacuum insulation chambers with very high performing multiple pumps to 
evacuate air and achieve high degree of vacuum insulation.
Insulation works on the principle of resisting three modes of heat transfer. Heat loss due to convection and conduction is prevented by vacuum 
insulation. Heat transfer caused by radiation is controlled dual technology of electrolysis and copper coating.
